description: Request an Evolize accessibility assessment of a publicly reachable website, then read the result with get_scan_result. By default a completed assessment up to 24 hours old is reused; pass refresh=true to require newly executed work (for example after deploying a fix). This CREATES work: it can start a real browser-based scan whose result is retained and may become a public report under Evolize's existing publication policy. Free public assessments are bounded: a completed result up to 24h old is reused unless refresh=true, at most 3 newly executed assessments per website per 24h, and the platform's own per-IP, per-domain and global scan limits still apply.

refresh.description: Require newly executed work instead of reusing a recent completed assessment. Use after deploying a fix. Never satisfied by an older completed report.

url.description: The public website to assess, e.g. `example.com` or `https://example.com`. Not an Evolize URL.

name: scan_website
title: Request an accessibility assessment
